code='''
import torch,json
def grow(L,seeds,n,name):
    p=f'model.language_model.layers.{L}.mlp.'
    S=0
    for m,dim in [('gate_proj',1),('up_proj',1),('down_proj',0)]:
        M=W(p+m+'.weight')
        M=M if dim==1 else M.T
        M=torch.nn.functional.normalize(M,dim=1)
        S=S+(M@M[seeds].T).mean(1)
    S[seeds]=1e9
    idx=S.topk(n).indices.tolist()
    json.dump({'kind':'mlp_cluster','layer':L,'indices':sorted(idx)},open(f'/work/{name}.json','w'))
    return idx
'''
open('/work/grow.py','w').write(code); exec(code); print('saved')
